title: My grandmother's 70th birthday
situation: Last weekend your family had a big party for your grandmother's 70th birthday. Your English friend, Sam, has asked you in an e-mail what you did at the weekend. Write an e-mail to Sam about the party.
situationHu: A családod a hétvégén a nagymamád 70. születésnapját ünnepelte; írj erről e-mailt angol barátodnak, Samnek.

points.text: say where the party was and who came
describe what you did or ate at the party
say what present you gave your grandmother and how she liked it

usefulPhrases.en: We had a party for my gran's 70th birthday.
The whole family was there, even my cousins from …
usefulPhrases.hu: Az egész család ott volt, még az unokatestvéreim is …-ból/-ből.

usefulPhrases.en: We gave her … as a present.

checklistExtra: Múlt időben (past simple) meséltem el, mi történt a bulin?
